description: Lecce publishes its street directory and road graph with districts, hamlets and municipal boundaries for the SmartEnCity project. Metadata names corrections against Census 2010 and the 2018 territorial reorganisation. CSV/spreadsheet labels state 2019; geospatial exports include SHP, GeoJSON and a ZIP described as containing SQLite. Source coordinates are RDN 2008 UTM zone 33 N, with GeoJSON in WGS84 EPSG 4326. These are declarations; actual connectivity, geometry quality and file contents were not inspected. Coverage is Lecce, Puglia, Italy. The licence declared by native metadata is CC-BY-4.0. The public catalogue provides descriptive metadata and the listed distribution links. Costs, access conditions for later file use and present completeness remain unknown. The supplied facts come from source descriptions and distribution labels; data values and file contents were not inspected. No specific simulation method is documented. Related resources may overlap this inventory or time period, but no further exact relationship is established by the inspected metadata.
